localAdaptations: Swift Transport.swift: remove hostname localhost from HTTP loopback exception; numeric loopback only.
Android core namespace is com.proxycept.reactnative.core to avoid duplicate upstream classes.
Android ProxyceptLogger.kt: foreground timer control and optional explicit installation/debug-session metadata, redacted before spool.
Android Spool.kt: owner-only directory and file permissions in addition to Android noBackupFilesDir location.
Native bridge controllers are independent adapter source; they validate all scalar attributes before engine admission.
Existing engine tests are copied from public MIT SDKs; Swift URL test adapted for numeric-loopback-only policy.

Correlation blocker follow-up: reject non-null empty/overlength correlation IDs in RN admission, Swift/Kotlin core construction and recovery; Android wire requires a JSON string or null and preserves Unicode scalar boundaries. The copied Kotlin limits test now supplies an in-range correlation ID.

Swift close follow-up: serialized deterministic fd release before close returns, idempotent fd sentinel, separate in-flight close waiters, and no persistence after ownership release; retained-client reopen and stale-writer regression.
releaseIntegrationNote: Reviewed upstream opt-in request-tagging helpers added since the original source snapshot and ported them, with their tests, into the bundled native cores. No JavaScript auto-tagging or implicit header injection is introduced.
